AT.statute: Kommunalsteuer and Dienstgeberbeitrag recorded under payroll; Stabilitätsabgabe (banks)

BE.statute: Taxe sur les comptes-titres recorded under net wealth; regional taxes

DE.statute: Kirchensteuer (Land church-tax laws, 8-9 % of income tax); Gewerbesteuer recorded under CIT

ES.statute: Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas (TRLRHL arts. 78-91); temporary bank and energy levies (Ley 38/2022)

FR.statute: CVAE (CGI art. 1586 ter, being phased out); CFE (CGI art. 1447); taxe d'habitation on second homes

HU.statute: Helyi iparűzési adó (local business tax on adjusted turnover, up to 2 %); KATA/KIVA small-business regimes; windfall/sector surtaxes (2022-2025)

IT.statute: IRAP (D.Lgs. 446/1997) recorded under CIT; imposta di bollo on financial statements (DPR 642/1972)

PL.statute: Podatek od niektórych instytucji finansowych (bank tax 0.0366 %/month); podatek od sprzedaży detalicznej

PT.statute: Contribuição extraordinária sobre o setor energético; derrama estadual (recorded under CIT)

RU.statute: Transport tax (НК гл. 28, regional), mineral extraction tax (гл. 26)
